verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email-sending service, since products of this kind can ship self-hostable editions, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable SES. The docs describe SES only as a managed AWS service reached through its API, SDK or SMTP endpoint, and relaying an existing mail server through SES is not self-hosting the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
